about: Spec 3.5.0 (acp.md *Scheduled work on a linked computer*): what a device makes of a scheduled turn. `accept`: the device's Accept scheduled work (remote.scheduled; false means remote work is off as well, the same refusal); `mode`: the schedule's (absent: none chosen); `max_mode`: remote.max_mode; `approval_wait_s`: the schedule's wait (absent: none). → `{mode, wait_s}` — the session's mode and how long an approval waits — or `{refused}` with the `data.reason` of the -32602 (`scheduled_off`, `plan`), whose message is loop.json scheduled.texts.off / .plan. Written from the rules; the device's other refusals (folder, trust) are the agent chat's.

cases.about: Off by default: refused, whatever else is asked.
No mode chosen, the device allows Auto: still Edit — Auto only when the schedule says so.
Auto chosen, the device allows Edit at most: lowered.
Edit chosen, the device allows Manual at most: lowered.
Plan is refused: nobody is there to approve a plan.
An unknown mode is read as the default, never as anything wider.
The device allows Plan at most: every scheduled turn is lowered to it.
The wait, in seconds, as the schedule says.
A fraction is cut to whole seconds.
